# Condition Parameter

A named binding that instantiates a condition template — 'threshold = 0.8', 'jurisdiction = Canada'. Lets one Condition serve many norms with different bindings.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ConditionParameter>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:ConditionParameter`  

**Type:** `gufo:Kind`, `owl:Class`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/norms>
